svg.aria-label: Single sign-on: apps A and B both trust one identity provider. The first visit to app A redirects to the identity provider to log in, which leaves a session there; visiting app B redirects again but the user is already logged in, so they return immediately with an assertion or ID token.
svg.title: Single sign-on: apps A and B both trust one identity provider. The first visit to app A redirects to the identity provider to log in, which leaves a session there; visiting app B redirects again but the user is already logged in, so they return immediately with an assertion or ID token.
svg.text: logs in once, keeps a session
